source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: As of December 31, 2024, there were approximately 34 stockholders of record of our Class A common stock, 37 stockholders of record of our Class B common stock, and no stockholders of record of our Class C common stock.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's year-end 2024 holdings data file ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); the same line in NBIM's equity CSV download (https://www.nbim.no/api/investments/v2/report/?assetType=eq&date=2024-12-31&fileType=csv) reads "North America;United States;Reddit Inc;Technology;817924784;72017221;0.06%;0.25%". CalPERS: its Form 13F for the quarter ended December 31, 2024 lists no shares or ADRs of Reddit. Holders of record: Listed Class A only; the 10-K also gives 37 holders of record of Class B.
